subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw add any text-to-tool-call recovery for the vLLM/gpt-oss failure mode, or require a raw structured-SSE repro and keep execution limited to structured `delta.tool_calls`?
rationale: The reported workaround idea includes reclassifying JSON-shaped assistant text into executable tool calls, which is safety-sensitive and not settled by the current generic parser tests.

options.title: Require a raw SSE fixture first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a minimal vLLM/gpt-oss stream proves whether structured `delta.tool_calls` are still misparsed on current main, then fix the generic structured parser if needed.

options.title: Approve scoped recovery
options.body: Allow a tightly gated vLLM/gpt-oss recovery path only when the stream terminal and provider metadata prove the text came from a tool-call response.

options.title: Close after live release proof
options.body: Close this issue only if a maintainer or reporter verifies v2026.6.11 or current main executes tools for the exact large-prompt vLLM/gpt-oss scenario.

recommendation.title: Require a raw SSE fixture first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a minimal vLLM/gpt-oss stream proves whether structured `delta.tool_calls` are still misparsed on current main, then fix the generic structured parser if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged PR most directly touched the safety boundary for when parsed OpenAI-compatible streamed tool calls become executable.
